# Terms of Service

Last updated: October 14, 2026

These Terms of Service (the “Terms”) are a binding agreement between you and PWL Solutions LLC, an Indiana limited liability company (“PWL Solutions,” “we,” “us,” or “our”), which operates JobProfitAI, including the website at jobprofitai.com, the web application, the Weekly Profit Brief and related emails, and any related services (together, the “Service”).

We keep a record of each acceptance: the version, the date and time, and how you accepted. ## 1. What the Service does

JobProfitAI connects to a QuickBooks Online company that you authorize, copies job-related accounting data from it, and uses that data to calculate and display job profitability, estimate comparisons, data-quality checks, trends and, on some plans, forecasts and cross-job comparisons. It also produces written explanations and recommendations, some of which are generated by artificial intelligence (see Section 8), and can send you a Weekly Profit Brief by email.

The Service only reads from QuickBooks. It does not create, change or delete records in your QuickBooks company. The Service is an informational and analytical tool. It is not accounting, bookkeeping, tax, legal, financial or investment advice, and it does not replace a qualified professional. Decisions you make using the Service are yours.

The Service is intended for businesses and the people who work for them. It is not intended for personal, family or household use, and you must be at least 18 years old to use it.

## 2. Your account

- You must give accurate information when you sign up and keep your email address current. Some features, including the Weekly Profit Brief, stay off until you confirm your email address.
- You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity under your account. Tell us promptly at [support@jobprofitai.com](mailto:support@jobprofitai.com) if you believe your account has been accessed without your permission.

You remain responsible for that authorization and for ending the connection when it ends. A client login you create is view-only and shows only the company you choose for it; you are responsible for giving it to the right person and for removing it when they should no longer have access. When a client relationship ends, you can delete that client’s company data from Settings without affecting your other clients.

## 3. The QuickBooks connection

You connect QuickBooks Online through Intuit’s own authorization process. You confirm that you own the QuickBooks company you connect, or are authorized by its owner to connect it and to share its data with us for the purposes described in these Terms and our Privacy Policy.

We use your QuickBooks data to provide the Service to you, and we process it for you, not on Intuit’s behalf.

You can disconnect at any time from Settings, or from within your Intuit account. Disconnecting stops syncing, the Weekly Profit Brief, alerts and every other use of that company’s data. We keep the data already copied into JobProfitAI for 30 days after a disconnect, so you can reconnect the same company without losing its history, and then delete it. You can also delete a company’s data at any time from Settings, without deleting your account. If QuickBooks stops letting us read a company, for example because you disconnected JobProfitAI from your Intuit account, and it isn’t reconnected within 7 days, we treat it as disconnected. If your account goes 90 days without an active trial or subscription, we disconnect its QuickBooks companies and email you, and the same 30-day period begins.

Your use of QuickBooks Online is governed by your agreement with Intuit. JobProfitAI is not made, endorsed or certified by Intuit. QuickBooks and Intuit are trademarks of Intuit Inc. The Service depends on Intuit’s systems and programming interfaces, and we are not responsible for Intuit outages, changes Intuit makes to what data is available, or the accuracy of data in your QuickBooks company.

## 4. Free trial

New accounts get a free trial of 14 days with the features and limits of Profit Intelligence Pro, plus the view-only client logins of the Firm plan. No payment details are needed to start. Near the end of the trial we may offer a one-time extension of 14 days in exchange for completing a short feedback survey. The extension is available once per account.

When the trial ends, the analysis features switch off unless you subscribe. Your account and your data are not deleted when a trial ends, but Section 3 applies if you have not subscribed 90 days later. You will not be charged at the end of a trial, because no payment method is collected for it. We may change, limit or end the trial offer for new accounts at any time.

## 5. Subscriptions, automatic renewal and cancellation

### Plans and prices

We currently offer three monthly plans: Profit Intelligence at \$149 per month, Profit Intelligence Pro at \$299 per month, and Firm at \$79 per connected QuickBooks company per month with a minimum of 4 companies. On Firm, the number of companies billed changes as you connect and disconnect companies, and Stripe prorates the difference on your next invoice. Each plan’s features and limits (such as the number of QuickBooks companies you can connect) are described on our [Pricing page](/pricing) and in your Billing page. If you have more open jobs than Profit Intelligence covers, we will ask you to move to Profit Intelligence Pro; nothing stops working. Prices are in US dollars and do not include taxes. You are responsible for any sales, use or similar taxes that apply, and where we are required to collect them they will be shown on your invoice.

### Automatic renewal

Your subscription renews automatically every month, and your payment method is charged the then-current monthly price for your plan at the start of each monthly billing period, until you cancel.

Payments are processed by Stripe. At checkout you confirm that you agree to these Terms and to the automatic renewal. By subscribing, you authorize us, through Stripe, to charge your payment method for each renewal. Your first charge happens when you subscribe, and later charges happen on the same day of each following month.

### How to cancel

You can cancel online at any time, with no phone call and no notice period: open Billing in your JobProfitAI account, choose Manage Billing, and cancel in the Stripe billing portal. If you cannot access your account, email [support@jobprofitai.com](mailto:support@jobprofitai.com) from the address on the account and we will cancel it for you. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing period you have already paid for. You keep access until then and are not charged again.

### Changing plans

You can switch between Profit Intelligence and Profit Intelligence Pro from the Stripe billing portal. To move to or from the Firm plan, email [support@jobprofitai.com](mailto:support@jobprofitai.com) and we will switch it for you. Stripe prorates a change, which means you may be charged the difference right away or receive a credit toward future invoices. If you move to a plan with lower limits, nothing is deleted, but some features may stop working, and you cannot connect additional QuickBooks companies while you are over your plan’s limit.

### Refunds

Except where the law requires otherwise, payments are non-refundable, and we do not give refunds or credits for partial months, unused features or periods when you did not use the Service. We may choose to give a refund or credit in a particular case. Doing so does not create an obligation to do the same in the future.

### Failed payments

If a renewal payment fails, Stripe will retry it and we will let you know by email. You keep access while payment is being retried. If payment cannot be collected, your access to the paid features is paused until the balance is paid or you choose a plan again. Your data is not deleted because a payment failed, unless your account then goes 90 days without an active subscription (see Section 3).

### Price changes

We may change our prices. We will email you at least 30 days before a price change applies to your subscription, and the new price will take effect at your next renewal after that notice period. If you do not want to pay the new price, you can cancel before it takes effect.

## 7. Accuracy of results

Every figure in JobProfitAI is calculated from the data in your QuickBooks company and the details you enter, such as estimates, target margins, job types and job status. If that data is incomplete, miscategorized, assigned to the wrong job or out of date, the results will be too. The Service includes data-quality checks to help you find these problems, but it cannot detect every one.

Forecasts, projections, comparisons and benchmarks are estimates based on past and current data. They are not predictions we guarantee, and actual results can differ. You are responsible for checking any figure against your own records before relying on it for a pricing, bidding, lending, tax, legal or other significant business decision.

The figures on our website, in the sample-data demo, in our videos and in our ads come from a made-up example company. They show how the Service works. They are not results any customer has achieved, and they are not a promise of what you will find in your own data.

## 8. Artificial intelligence features

Some text in the Service, including advisor notes on profit opportunities, the written summary in the Weekly Profit Brief and suggested job types you ask for, is generated by an AI model provided by a third party (currently Anthropic, with processing restricted to the United States). To produce it, we send that provider the calculated profitability information for your jobs, which includes job names, the customer names attached to them, job types and calculated figures. Your QuickBooks login and access tokens are never sent.

AI-generated text can be incomplete or wrong, even though the dollar amounts and percentages it refers to are calculated by our software, not by the AI model. Treat AI-generated explanations and recommendations as suggestions to review, not as professional advice, and check them against the job pages before acting on them. Suggested job types are never applied until you accept them.

Profit opportunities, estimate checks and tracked results are calculations from your QuickBooks data and the targets you set. They describe what happened on your past jobs and what the same pattern would mean for others; they are not a promise of future results, and pricing decisions are yours.

## 15. Referral and partner programs

### Customer referral program

If someone signs up through your referral link and subscribes, you earn a credit once at least 30 days have passed since their first payment, their first monthly renewal has been paid, their subscription is still active and not set to cancel, and no payment has been fully refunded or charged back. The credit equals one month of your own current plan (on Firm, one month at its 4-company minimum), or what the referred account has paid for its subscription so far, less refunds and taxes, if that is less. Credits are applied to your Stripe account balance and come off future JobProfitAI invoices automatically. If you are not subscribed when a credit is earned, it is held and applied when you subscribe. Credits have no cash value, cannot be transferred, and are not refundable. A referred account can be credited to only one referrer, and you cannot refer yourself or an account you control. If the payment that qualified a credit is later fully refunded or charged back, we may reverse the credit.

### Partner program

Accounting and bookkeeping firms approved into our partner program earn a commission on the subscription payments of clients they refer, except on the Firm plan. The commission rate is 20% while 1 to 9 of your referred clients are paying, 25% while 10 to 24 of your referred clients are paying, and 30% while 25 or more of your referred clients are paying, counted at the time each payment is made. Commission is calculated on subscription revenue actually collected, excluding taxes, for each referred client’s first 12 paid months. The rate that applies when a payment is made is fixed for that payment. Commission on a payment that is fully refunded or charged back before we pay it out is reversed. If we have already paid it, we will review it with you before making any adjustment.

Commissions are recorded in your partner dashboard and paid by us manually to the payout contact you provide. We may ask for tax information (such as a Form W-9) before paying, and you are responsible for your own taxes on commissions. We may approve or decline partner applications at our discretion, and we may suspend a partner or withhold commissions connected with fraud, self-referral, misleading promotion or a breach of these Terms. Partners may not describe JobProfitAI inaccurately, offer discounts we have not authorized, or make claims on our behalf. Commission is paid only on subscriptions a referred customer pays for, and never on the Firm plan: not on QuickBooks companies on a Firm account, which that account pays for, and not on a referred firm’s own Firm subscription. Firm accounts also don’t count toward the number of paying referred clients that sets your commission rate. Any complimentary account offered to partners is provided at our discretion, set up with you directly, and limited to the plan we tell you (currently Profit Intelligence Pro, for up to 3 companies); it does not include the Firm plan.

### Recommending JobProfitAI

If you can earn a referral credit or a partner commission, then whenever you recommend JobProfitAI, publicly or to your clients, you must clearly tell people that you may earn a credit or commission, as the Federal Trade Commission’s rules on endorsements require. You may not promote JobProfitAI with unsolicited bulk email or messages, or in any way that breaks anti-spam or privacy laws; bid on JobProfitAI or similar names as keywords in search ads; or use our name or logo in a way that suggests you are JobProfitAI or speak for us. We may withhold or reverse credits and commissions earned in breach of these rules.

### Both programs

Referral status gives no one access to another account’s data. We may change or end either program for the future by updating these Terms or the program page. Credits and commissions already earned under the terms in effect at the time will be honored, except where they are reversed for the reasons described above.
